scope: Ordinary Kimi selected-expert working-set composition for two distinct source codecs; generated numerical bytes, not publisher payload and not complete model inference.

generated_data.storage: Generated only in process memory; no large numerical weight-bank files were created or archived.
generated_data.seed: Fixed arithmetic generator with no RNG: each row has one nonzero encoded weight; column=(row*17+expert*13+leg*7)%K, code=1+(expert+leg)%3, fixed two BF16 input patterns.

math.Quark: U8 adjacent E2M1 W + U8 E8M0 SF; dynamic BF16 A32 quantize/dequantize, even scale and half-even codes; BF16 operands/Y, F32 dot. Shared FFN uses the same MX contract; latent/router remain BF16/F32.
math.K512: I32 low-nibble-first offset-binary W + F32 SF; original per512 BF16 scale/reciprocal/I8 truncation, I32 dot then ordered BF16 group products/sum. Shared and latent projections are BF16.
math.SiTU: Explicit BF16 gate/up -> Cast F32 -> 4*tanh(g/4)*sigmoid(g) times25*tanh(u/25) -> Cast BF16 once. Graph uses existing source-equation reciprocal-literal formation; independent nonlinear oracle checks F32/transcendental plus BF16 interval, not bitwise upstream runtime equality.
math.separate_FP8_branch: Quark f_a_proj is an independent [128,7168] E4 channel-W/token-A projection on original hidden input, not a fictitious FFN stage. Independent scalar E4/RNE oracle checks its256 values exactly; SW=1 in this fixture does not newly discriminate scale-product order.
math.router: Actual F32 logits/sigmoid+bias Top16; exact IDs and normalized uncorrected sigmoid weights checked before selected-only upload.
math.allocation_contract: Same existing WeightSlots/WeightBatch, Graph and retirement machinery; seven banks atomically bind. No new public op, IR, executor, registry or supplier.
